title: 睡觉需要长时间等待
description: 睡觉需要玩家盯着屏幕等待22.5分钟，没有直接跳过时间的选项，鼓励挂机而非游玩。
evidence: I dread sleeping. I love how the game is real life but that means if your character is solo and go to sleep, with a maximum x16 fast forward option available, you need to stare to the screen for 22,5 minutes doing nothing to get a 6-hour sleep. This is the game encouraging to go afk instead of you know, play the game. There needs to be a "sleep for x hours" option that makes that time pass by instantly.
